title: AC1015 simple.dwg LTYPE_CONTROL outlier screen
scope: Investigate one local AC1015 read failure against the authoritative ODA wire description and an independent reader. No parser behavior or support claim is changed.

source.provenance: Unauthenticated local corpus file; not committed.

localReader.observation: The LTYPE_CONTROL is type 56, handle 0x05. Its parsed object size is 520 bits, equal to the full 520-bit frame. Count decodes as 25, but the reader's bounded control parser refuses at the LTYPE count/boundary check before callbacks; the file returns BAD_READ_TABLES.

authoritativeSpecification.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authoritativeSpecification.relevantRule: For R2000, Obj size is the size in bits of the object, not including end handles. The common handle-reference sequence is described after the object fields.

independentReader.result: SUCCESS; JSON reports LTYPE_CONTROL handle 0x05, size 65 bytes / 520 bits, and 25 entries. This is independent tolerant-reader evidence, not proof that the local frame matches the ODA layout.

trackedControlComparison.observation: The local reader parses its type-56 LTYPE_CONTROL (reported object size 72 bits) without a LTYPE-control failure; its later strict conversion refusal is the separate incomplete-read gate.

decision: Do not relax the AC1015 LTYPE_CONTROL boundary or infer an inline-handle compatibility profile from this one unauthenticated source. Require producer provenance or an additional source profile whose source layout and count/handle boundary agree with ODA v5.4.1.
